identity.name: The Neural Architect

identity.target_audience: Recruiters, Hiring Managers, Tech Leads at top AI/ML firms

components.name: HeroSection

components.name: AboutSection
components.description: Asymmetric layout. Left: Profile photo (vineet.jpeg) with glitch/reveal effect. Right: Bio text and 'Core Principle' block quote styled as a code comment.

components.name: ProjectGallery
components.description: Bento Grid layout. Featured project (Geomagnetic Storm) takes 2x2 span. Other projects 1x1. Cards have tilt effect on hover and 'View Project' magnetic button.

components.name: SkillMatrix

components.name: ExperienceTimeline
components.description: Vertical line with nodes. Active node glows. Content fades in as user scrolls down. Connecting line animates (draws itself).

components.name: ContactFooter
components.description: Large footer. 'Let's Build Something Great'. Big email link. Social icons with magnetic pull.

content_map.name: Vineet Vora
content_map.bio: I'm a systems-minded ML builder who enjoys working where things are still unclear. I like taking ideas that exist only on paper and turning them into measurable, scalable systems.
content_map.quote: A model isn't finished when it converges. It's finished when its behavior is understood, testable, and reliable under real constraints.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize a React project with Vite.
2. Install Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, lucide-react, and clsx/tailwind-merge.
3. Set up the 'Neural Architect' theme in tailwind.config.js specifically extending colors.
4. Create the components in 'src/components' as specified.
5. Use the provided image URLs for project backgrounds. Use a placeholder or the local 'vineet.jpeg' for the profile.
6. Ensure the site is fully responsive (mobile-first).
7. Implement smooth scrolling (lenis recommended or CSS scroll-behavior).
8. Add a download button for the resume (link to a placeholder PDF if not available).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use gradients for dark colors.
Avoid generic centered layouts; use asymmetry.
Add micro-interactions to all buttons and cards.
Ensure text contrast meets accessibility standards (APCA preferred).
Use 'Space Grotesk' for headings and 'Inter' for body.
Do NOT use emojis for icons; use Lucide React icons.
